description: Somos un grupo de Itesitos (ITC) en busca de nuevos aprendizajes y obtener grandes experiencias. como un sabio chino dijo una vez "Hazlo por los jajas"
summary:
SpaceCats is a game where the goal is to design space missions that accomplish certain tasks in a quest to learn more about the ancient dog alien civilization. Via collaboration our protagonists need to plan a route, build a space-worthy vessel, and follow this route.

It addresses the challenge directly by using it as a set of requirements that we had to accomplish. We modeled a simpler system than others due to the time constraint of the hackathon and our imposed challenge of using as little Super Intelligence (SI) as possible.
details:
Quick facts:

* We received no mentoring.

* SI was not used until the implementation stage of the project.

* We wrote it in the free game engine Godot using their language, GodotScript.

As for impact we wanted to make a game that made you want to learn more about space and everything a space mission entailed. Our key inspirations were existing games like Kerbal Space Program (KSP) and Bad Piggies.

Our game is creative as we were the sole people responsible for planning it out and making art assets.
